title: 3 arrested as police seize P3.7-M illegal cigarettes in Camarines Sur

blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY, Albay — Police arrested three individuals and seized suspected illegal cigarettes worth P3.719 million in a law enforcement operation in Barangay Godofredo Reyes Sr., Ragay, Camarines Sur on Tuesday, November 17. Lt. Col. Maria Luisa Calubaquib, Bicol police spokesperson, said the operation was conducted around 2:30 p.m. by police personnel, who initially seized cigarette products worth P3.458 million bearing Carnival, ModernZJTI, Farstar, Concord and Modern Menthol brands. READ: Village chief arrested for illegal drugs in Camarines Sur Calubaquib said additional cigarettes worth P261,000 were recovered from a black Suzuki Ertiga allegedly used by the supplier to deliver more stocks.
